description.value: Sushi Bar Shyun is a small, reservation-recommended Japanese restaurant in Port Coquitlam that has been crafting authentic sushi since 2004. The name 'Shyun' means 'in season,' reflecting the kitchen's commitment to local, fresh ingredients and limited-quantity seasonal fish imported directly from Japan. All sauces are house-made, and the menu spans traditional nigiri, sashimi, and maki including several vegetarian rolls.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, address (#102-1250 Dominion Ave, Port Coquitlam, matching OSM), and supplies a phone/text number (604-944-4411) absent from OSM tags. The About Us page establishes this as an authentic Japanese restaurant operating since 2004, focused on seasonal and local ingredients. The menu labels several maki rolls explicitly as 'Vegetarian,' and the temporary operational notice referencing 'walk-ins (both dine and take out)' implies normal takeout service; no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number 604-944-4411 is sourced from the website only; OSM has no phone tag to cross-check, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.

As of 2026-05-28 (within the May 24–June 7 window), the restaurant is in a limited operating mode: text reservations only, no walk-ins, and a restricted sushi/sashimi-only menu — this is stated as temporary.
URL discovery confidence was rated 'medium' but website content fully corroborates the business name and address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, long-established restaurant (since 2004) with a confirmed address, live website, and a broad menu including vegetarian options; a legitimate Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists passing through Port Coquitlam.

Takeout.detail: Website temporary notice states 'We will not be able to... serve walk-ins (both dine and take out)' during a limited period, confirming that takeout is a normal part of operations

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels five maki items as 'Vegetarian': Oshinko (pickled radish), Ume-jiso (real plum), Kanpyo (home-made), Natto (real natto bean), and Kappa (cucumber)

wow_evidence: reservation-recommended Japanese restaurant...crafting authentic sushi since 2004
